name: Help! My girlfriend is an ancient demon and if I don't please them, everyone will perish!
source:
Chari is just another regular student at Saint Agatha's Catholic all-girls high school:

Abysmal grades,
Crippling social anxiety,
A demonic girlthing-friend that is going to end the world in three days,
And another girlfriend that has to stop her--even it means ending Chari's life...

[Edited from [url=https://spiderzone.itch.io/help-my-girlfriend-is-an-ancient-deity]itch.io[/url]]
